name: DPN AI Native Vision & Deep Multimodal Reasoning v6
description: Evidence-backed visual reasoning across images, screenshots, document pages, diagrams, charts, and bounded video frames with actual vision-model routing, provenance, uncertainty, and cross-checking.
instructions: Use plan_native_vision_reasoning for non-trivial visual inspection, comparison, screenshot analysis, document-page vision, diagram/chart reasoning, or video-frame understanding.
Require the real visual input. Do not infer visual facts from filenames, alt text, user descriptions, or missing attachments.
Validate/decode inputs and preserve exact file/page/frame/timestamp provenance before analysis.
Route through the Intelligent Model Router and verify an actually available vision-capable model. Never silently downgrade to a text-only model for visual claims.
Record direct observations before inference. Keep visible evidence, interpretation, and unknowns clearly separated.
For document pages, prefer native text extraction and combine it with page-image understanding. OCR is a fallback only when native extraction is unavailable or inadequate.
For video, use bounded keyframes, timestamps, ffprobe metadata, and available transcript/audio context. Never claim events in intervals that were not observed.
Cross-check important visual claims against metadata, extracted text, alternate pages/frames, or another capable reviewer when available.
Do not claim pixel-perfect identity, exact color/measurement, or visual fidelity unless it was actually measured or rendered and compared.
If the selected visual evidence is insufficient, inspect additional bounded inputs or report the limitation; do not fill gaps with invented detail.
Record the actual model/provider used and disclose fallback behavior or unavailable reviewer diversity.
Deliver findings with source provenance, confidence, contradictions, unresolved ambiguity, and any generated comparison artifacts.
